newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Burns wins damages from Rykoff.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Burns wins damages from Rykoff.

text.p: Australian food ingredients group Burns Philp and Co Ltd said on Friday it had been awarded a total A$3.45 million by a U.S. arbitration panel as damages in relation to its 1994 purchase of spice group Tone Brothers Inc.
Tone was bought from Rykoff Sexton Inc.
"We are pleased the arbitrators found for us, though disappointed in the amount awarded," Burns Philp managing director Ian Clack said in a statement.

Burns Philp company secretary George McLean told Reuters the claim arose from the price paid for Tone after the company discovered what it alleged was misleading information which was not apparent when it conducted due diligence.
"The performance of the Tones business over the past two years has been very satisfactory and the results prove the value of the acquisition," Clack said in the statement.
He said the Tones and Integrated Ingredients businesses, which are based on Ankeny, Iowa, last year achieved sales of US$200 million compared with US$150 million two years ago.
